'''Damatal Holonews''' was a [[NewsNet]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. [[Jamson Freller]] gave an interview to Damatal Holonews shortly before the [[Esselian Hall]] [[Esselian Hall election, 2 ABY|elections]].
